currentApprovalStatus: All listed candidates are owner-approved for testing. Public website content still requires store-specific verification before publishing.
policy: No API result goes live without owner approval.
API-sourced product names, packaging, prices and availability must be checked against the store first.
Adult-only products must keep legal-age and valid-ID language.
Reject any source that changes brand packaging, invents inventory or suggests youth-focused language.

candidates.name: Chomp grocery product API
candidates.proposedUse: Optional product-name lookup for snacks, grocery and non-age-restricted convenience items.
candidates.approvalQuestion: Should we test this for snack/grocery product lookup only, with every result reviewed before publishing?
candidates.risk: May return products, package names or descriptions that do not match Harrison inventory.

candidates.name: Best Buy product API
candidates.proposedUse: Reference-only catalog testing for broad product metadata patterns, not store inventory.
candidates.approvalQuestion: Should this stay in research only unless a result clearly helps website structure?
candidates.risk: Retailer catalog is not Harrison inventory and could mislead customers if published.

candidates.name: BuyWhere catalog API
candidates.proposedUse: Research possible product names or categories for review, not automatic website content.
candidates.approvalQuestion: Should we test this only as a weekly candidate source for owner review?
candidates.risk: Catalog data can be incomplete, region-specific or inaccurate for local store availability.

candidates.name: EmailJS
candidates.proposedUse: Upgrade the customer request form from mailto to direct website email delivery.
candidates.approvalQuestion: Should we set up EmailJS so customer requests submit without opening the visitor email app?
candidates.risk: Requires account setup and public client-side configuration; must be tested carefully.

candidates.name: Open-Meteo
candidates.proposedUse: Weather-aware shopping prompts on the offer page.
candidates.approvalQuestion: Keep this live weather prompt on featured offers?
candidates.risk: Low. Does not claim inventory or pricing and has a fallback.
